title: Clan Primer category index (hctgf, menuhandbook_<category>.bin)

container.notes: Little-endian, magic 'hctgf\0\0\0'. Reference writer order: 24-byte header; s32 header names from 0x18; header-details block B (u16 count, u16 offsets relative to B, items each padded to 4); entry-picture table at the absolute entryExtendedInfoOffset (u16 each, pad to 4); entry table at the absolute entryBasicInfoOffset (12 bytes each); footer block F right after it (u16 count, u16 offsets relative to F, pad to 16, 8-byte items, pad to 16 = EOF). Always read through stored offsets. Strings live in the category's text .dat tables; pictures in its himgd packs (container-himgd, tim2). Folder: myoshiok (exact subfolder unrecorded).

fields.name: type
fields.notes: Meaning unknown. Keep it unchanged.

fields.name: entryBasicInfoOffset
fields.notes: ABSOLUTE file offset of the hctgfEntryBasicInfo table (4-aligned). Recompute when anything before it changes length.

fields.name: entryExtendedInfoOffset
fields.notes: ABSOLUTE file offset of the hctgfEntryExtendedInfo table (4-aligned).

fields.name: headerBasicInfoCount
fields.notes: Number of s32 header-name ids starting at 0x18.

fields.name: imagesFileLinkOffset
fields.notes: Base link to the category's himgd image packs (hypothesis: number of the first image .dat).

fields.name: imagesFileCount
fields.notes: Number of image files (hypothesis: number of himgd packs).

records.name: hctgfHeaderBasicInfo
records.where: file offset 0x18 (directly after the header); record i at 0x18 + 4*i

fields.name: name
fields.notes: Number of the header/page title string (string table mapping unverified).

fields.name: count
fields.notes: Number of header-details items (C).

fields.name: offset
fields.notes: Offset of item k RELATIVE TO B. Items are 4-aligned. The reference writer starts item 0 at B + 4 + 2*C; keep the original gap.

records.name: hctgfHeaderExtendedItemHead
records.where: B + itemOffset[k]; followed by contents[contentCount] and locations[locationCount] (u16 each), then zero padding to 4

bits.name: unknownLowNibble
bits.notes: Written 0 by the reference tool; keep it unchanged.

fields.name: content
fields.notes: Meaning unverified (perhaps entries shown under this header).

fields.name: location
fields.notes: Meaning unverified (perhaps map/location numbers).

records.name: hctgfEntryExtendedInfo
records.where: file offset hctgfHeader.entryExtendedInfoOffset; table zero-padded to 4 at its end

fields.name: imageFileLink
fields.notes: Picture shown for the entry; observed range about 0-296. Probably a running image number across the category's himgd packs (unverified).

records.name: hctgfEntryBasicInfo
records.where: file offset hctgfHeader.entryBasicInfoOffset; record i at + 12*i

fields.name: name
fields.notes: Number of the entry title string.

fields.name: headerBasicInfoLink
fields.notes: Index into hctgfHeaderBasicInfo: the header this entry is listed under.

fields.name: textFileLink
fields.notes: Which text table (.dat) holds the entry body.

fields.name: entryExtendedInfoLink
fields.notes: Index into hctgfEntryExtendedInfo (the picture).

bits.name: autoUnlock
bits.notes: Entry is available without a trigger.

bits.name: unknownBits1to7
bits.notes: Cleared by the reference writer; keep it unchanged.

fields.name: reserved
fields.notes: Written 0 by the reference tool; keep it unchanged.

records.name: hctgfEntryFooterBlockCount
records.where: F = entryBasicInfoOffset + 12*entryBasicInfoCount (directly after the entry table)

fields.name: count
fields.notes: Number of footer items (K).

records.name: hctgfEntryFooterItemOffset
records.where: F + 2; slot k at F + 2 + 2*k; the list is followed by zero padding to a 16-byte file boundary

fields.name: offset
fields.notes: Offset of footer item k RELATIVE TO F.

records.name: hctgfEntryFooterItem
records.where: F + itemOffset[k]; items are 8 bytes, 16-aligned start; file zero-padded to 16 after the last

fields.name: tail
fields.notes: Not read by any source; the reference writer zeroes it. Possibly up to 7 one-byte values. Keep it unchanged.

roundTrip: Read every table through its stored offset (absolute for entry tables, block-relative for header-details and footer items).
Keep: type, the low nibble of each header-details counts byte, flags bits 1-7, the reserved byte of each entry, and the 7 tail bytes of each footer item (the reference writer zeroes them).
Keep the original gap between the header-details offset list and its first item (the reference writer always places item 0 at B + 4 + 2*C; vanilla rule for odd C unknown).
Alignment: header-details items padded to 4; entry-picture table padded to 4; footer offset list padded to a 16-byte file boundary; footer items end on 16 (EOF).

After a length change recompute entryExtendedInfoOffset, entryBasicInfoOffset, the relative item offsets of both blocks and all counts; links (headerBasicInfoLink, entryExtendedInfoLink) past an inserted/removed record must be renumbered.
Offsets are u16: the file must stay below 64 KiB.
gaps: Meaning of header type, header-details contents/locations, footer items and their tail bytes.
Which string table/number space the s32 name fields use.
How imagesFileLinkOffset, imagesFileCount and imageFileLink map onto himgd file numbers and image slots.
Vanilla padding between the header-details offset list and its first item when the item count is odd.
Archive subfolder of the menuhandbook files (bestiary text is under 'myoshiok').
